subject: WL
title: Spanish IV
description: Spanish IV moves students toward Intermediate Mid–High proficiency through thematic units modeled on the AP Spanish Language and Culture themes: personal and public identities, families and communities, science and technology, beauty and aesthetics, contemporary life, global challenges, and Hispanic literature. Students read and listen to authentic sources daily, hold sustained conversations, write formal essays and emails, and give presentations, while mastering advanced grammar (imperfect subjunctive, si clauses, perfect tenses, passive voice). Spanish is the language of instruction.
framework: 2019 California World Languages Standards (Intermediate Mid target); 2020 California World Languages Framework

standards.WL-COMM1-IM: Interpretive communication (Intermediate Mid): understand main ideas and many details in authentic texts, audio, and video on familiar and some unfamiliar topics.
standards.WL-COMM2-IM: Interpersonal communication (Intermediate Mid): sustain spontaneous conversations and written exchanges, asking and answering questions on a range of topics.
standards.WL-COMM3-IM: Presentational communication (Intermediate Mid): present information, narrate, and describe in connected sentences and paragraphs across time frames.
standards.WL-COMM4-IM: Settings for communication: use the language in real-world settings beyond the classroom, including digital communities.
standards.WL-COMM5-IM: Receptivity: recognize and use culturally appropriate gestures, register (tú/usted), and strategies to negotiate meaning.
standards.WL-COMM6-IM: Language comparisons: compare linguistic structures (e.g., subjunctive, aspect) of Spanish and English to deepen understanding of both.
standards.WL-CULT1-IM: Cultures: investigate, explain, and reflect on the relationship between practices, products, and perspectives of Spanish-speaking cultures.
standards.WL-CULT2-IM: Cultural comparisons: compare products, practices, and perspectives of Spanish-speaking cultures with one's own.
standards.WL-CONN1-IM: Connections: build, reinforce, and expand knowledge of other disciplines (history, science, art, literature) through Spanish.

units.title: Identidades personales y públicas
units.big_idea: Our identities are shaped by language, heritage, and the communities we belong to.

units.title: Familias y comunidades
units.big_idea: Family structures and community traditions differ across the Spanish-speaking world but serve similar human needs.

units.title: Ciencia y tecnología
units.big_idea: Technology changes how we live and communicate, raising new ethical questions.

units.title: Belleza y estética
units.big_idea: Art, architecture, and music express a culture's values and history.

units.title: La vida contemporánea: educación y trabajo
units.big_idea: Education, work, and leisure reflect each society's priorities and opportunities.

units.title: Desafíos mundiales: el medio ambiente y la salud
units.big_idea: Environmental and health challenges require global cooperation and local action.

units.title: Literatura hispana
units.big_idea: Literature lets us enter the perspectives of writers across the Spanish-speaking world.

units.title: Comunidades hispanohablantes en EE. UU. y California
units.big_idea: Spanish-speaking communities have shaped California's history, culture, and future.

units.title: Proyecto final y examen
units.big_idea: Proficiency is shown by communicating with confidence across all modes.
